name: Money and the Economy
description: The story of money and trade: shells and the first coins, paper money, banks and stock markets, the gold standard, the great crashes and depressions, the euro and Bitcoin.

checkpoints.name: The first money
checkpoints.note: People trade goods and use shells, grain and metal as money. Lydia strikes the first coins, China casts bronze coins with a hole, and the Roman denarius pays soldiers across an empire.

checkpoints.name: Coins, paper and trade
checkpoints.note: The gold dinar spreads with Islam, China prints the first paper money, Venice and Florence mint coins trusted across Europe, and Spanish silver from the Americas floods the world.

checkpoints.name: Banks and stock markets
checkpoints.note: The Dutch East India Company sells shares in Amsterdam, tulip prices soar and crash, the Bank of England is founded and Adam Smith explains how markets work.

checkpoints.name: Gold and industry
checkpoints.note: Britain ties the pound to gold, gold rushes draw people to California and Australia, Marx attacks capitalism, and after a run of panics the United States founds the Federal Reserve.

checkpoints.name: Crash, depression and Bretton Woods
checkpoints.note: Germany's money becomes worthless, Wall Street crashes and the Great Depression follows. After the war the world ties its money to the dollar at Bretton Woods, and the credit card is born.

checkpoints.name: Free markets and new crises
checkpoints.note: The dollar leaves gold, oil shocks and stock market crashes follow, the euro is launched, the dot-com bubble bursts and phones start to carry money.

checkpoints.name: From the crash to crypto
checkpoints.note: The financial crisis of 2008 shakes the world, Bitcoin is invented, Europe faces a debt crisis, the pandemic brings a sharp recession and new tariffs start trade wars.
